extracted.name: Wheat Flour Taco Tortilla
extracted.description: I kinda tinkered with several recipes for tortillas and this is the result. It's a well balanced recipe, with well thought out ratios for each ingredient.
instruction_lines: Mix the ingredients together until you form a smooth dough ball
Cover the dough in damp cloth for 10 min
Divide the dough into 16 smaller dough balls, each should weigh approximately 35 g
Roll each dough ball until they are as big as a small sized plate
Place individual tortillas on frying pan with no oil set on high heat
Place finished tortillas in a cloth, to preserve texture
Serve with Pico De Gallo, Rice, Beans and fryed minced meat
